incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A street in a residential area is flooded with brown water, reaching up to the bases of multi-story buildings. Buildings have storefronts on the ground floor and appear intact. Traffic signs are visible.

observations.description: Brown, murky water covers the entire street, reaching the bottom of building facades.
Multi-story buildings with commercial storefronts on the ground floor, some with arched doorways and balconies.
Street signs including a stop sign and directional arrow sign are visible on the right side of the image.
No vehicles visible in the flooded area.
No visible people in the image.

inconsistencies: Report mentions 'Nabeul' but the image shows European-style architecture; location cannot be confirmed from the image.
not_determinable: Scale of the flood in terms of area or depth
Whether roads are blocked beyond what is visible in the image
